traps.why: With AlCl₃ the acyl group goes on the ring (ketone). Without it, the phenol oxygen is acylated: an ester.
That is an ether. An ester needs an acyl chloride or anhydride, not an alkyl halide.
There is a reaction: CH₃COCl, pyr does change phenol.

explanation: Without a Lewis acid the phenol oxygen is the nucleophile: it attacks the acyl chloride / anhydride to give an aryl ester.
